dialogues.speaker: Venipi
dialogues.text: Well, officially I was an apprentice. In reality, I just hauled bricks.

dialogues.speaker: Venipi
dialogues.text: If there's one thing worth mentioning about those days...

dialogues.speaker: Venipi
dialogues.text: Back in the day, everyone working on The Mausoleum of King Deshret got two cups of beer every day.

dialogues.speaker: Venipi
dialogues.text: Ah, I miss those times... though I can't remember what it tasted like anymore.
